content: अशोक {%a.%} Without sorrow, not feeling or causing sorrow. .{@-कः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a tree having red flowers (Jonesia Asoka Roxb.); [said, according to the convention of poets, to put forth flowers when struck by ladies with the foot decked with jingling anklets and painted with lack-dye. Kālidāsa mentions the flowering of this tree in Spring (<ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Ṛs. 6. 5</ls>, <ls n="Ṛs. 6.">16</ls>). The painted foot bears a striking resemblance in colour to the flowers of Aśoka (<ab>cf.</ab> <ls>R. 8. 63</ls>). <ab>cf.</ab> असूत सद्यः कुसुमान्यशोकः … पादेन नापैक्षत सुन्दरीणां संपर्कमाशिञ्जितनूपुरेण <ls>Ku. 3. 26</ls>; <ls>Me. 80</ls>; <ls>R. 8. 62</ls>; <ls>M. 3. 12</ls>, <ls n="M. 3.">17</ls>; also पादाघातादशोकस्तिलककुरबकौ वीक्षणालिङ्गनाभ्याम् . स्त्रीणां स्पर्शात् प्रियङ्गुर्विकसति बकुलः सीधुगण्डूषसेकात् . मन्दारो नर्मवाक्यात् पटुमृदुहसनाच्चम्पको वक्त्रवातात् चूतो गीतान्नमेरुर्विकसति च पुरो नर्तनात्कर्णिकारः ..] .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a minister of king Daśaratha. (<ab>v. l.</ab> for अकोप. <ls>Rām. 1. 7. 3</ls>). .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a celebrated king of the Maurya dynasty, said to have reigned from 234-198 <ab>B. C.</ab> .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of the बकुल. tree अशोको वञ्जुले माने द्रुमनिःशोकयोर्मतः . वर्तते कटुरोहिण्याम् … <ls>Nm.</ls> .²6 Joy, happiness; अशोकजैः प्रीतिमयैः कपिमालिङ्गय संभ्रमात् . सिषेच भरतः श्रीमान्विपुलैरश्रुबिन्दुभिः .. <ls>Rām. 6. 125. 42</ls>. .{@-का@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a medical plant (कटुक; <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>कुटकी</ns>). .²2 The sixth day in the first half of Chaitra. .²3 One of the female domestic deities of the Jainas. .{@-कम्@} .²1 Quicksilver. .²2 The blossom of the Aśoka plant (forming one of the five arrows of Cupid).
